utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Nell. I’ll keep the locations listed clearly so we can stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s Sunday at the community center, and we still need the most help sorting tools and greeting folks at check-in. If you can help there, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s the spot I’d point people to too—sorting tools and greeting at check-in will make a big difference. I’ll spread the word and tell folks to bring tape or a sturdy box if they’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you check the nails and tape first? I’m keeping the list tight so we don’t miss the basics.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you want nails and tape checked first, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, nice — I might have a sturdy box somewhere. I’ll check and bring it if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, thanks — if you find it, just bring it by. If not, I can still use help with the most urgent repair items.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I’ll resend the repair drive details so you have the latest info, and I’ll keep everything clear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — that would be a huge help. If you can, please highlight that it’s Sunday at the community center and that we especially need folks to sort tools and greet people at check-in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Jules — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs to be gathered?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — we still need the locations Rey’s sending, plus tape and a sturdy box to keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — send the locations when you’ve got them, and I’ll keep everything noted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send over the locations I have soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send me the latest repair drive details and I’ll spread the invite right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn — we’re meeting Saturday morning at the community shed, and I’m still confirming the volunteer list and tool needs. I’ll send the final details once I lock them in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re mostly short on tools and hardware—if you can grab those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s the main thing, then — tools and hardware first. I’ll keep an eye on nails, tarps, and tape too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana — we still need a few basic tools and some sturdy supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — could you share the repair drive details again so I can make sure I have everything right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll bring over my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Start with the leaky sink and the front door hinge—they’re the most urgent. I’ll check what we’ve got for those.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you short on most for the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Start with the leaky sink and the front door hinge—they’re the most urgent. I’m still making the list of what else the repair drive needs.
